lemmas.name: ms50
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a1 a2 : Array Nat) (h : mergeSorted_precond a1 a2), mergeSorted_postcond a1 a2 (((a1.toList ++ a2.toList).mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).toArray) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a1 a2 h
  unfold mergeSorted_postcond
  rw [List.toList_toArray]
  exact ⟨List.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·) _, List.isPerm_iff.mpr (List.mergeSort_perm _ _)⟩
